description: Verify a GitHub release shipped consistently: git tag resolves to a real commit, package.json and the Python metadata (pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, setup.py) at the tag match, server.json matches when present, GitHub release is published, npm has the version and points latest at it (only when the repo has an npm package), PyPI has the version and points latest at it (only for Python projects, skipped when the project is not on PyPI), the MCP Registry lists it as latest, and GHCR has the image tag. Python projects also get soft structure evidence (tests, Dockerfile, README, MCP entry point). Returns a GO or NO-GO report with evidence per surface.

npmPackage.description: npm package name when it cannot be inferred from package.json at the tag

pypiPackage.description: PyPI package name when it cannot be inferred from the Python metadata

repo.description: Repo in owner/repo form, e.g. CloudCorpRecords/greenlight

require.description: Surfaces or groups to force as hard checks: npm, pypi, python, server, registry, ghcr, release, github

serverName.description: MCP Registry server name, defaults to io.github.<Owner>/<repo>

skip.description: Surfaces or groups to skip: npm, pypi, python, server, registry, ghcr, release, github

version.description: Expected version, e.g. 0.15.1. Omit to read it from package.json or the Python metadata on the default branch.

name: check_release
